start: 'Open MettleUp on my watch' on (default); watch connected with the MettleUp app

user_sees: The watch opens MettleUp's workout screen, or shows a 'Workout started' card that opens it with one tap
must_not: The watch opening twice for one workout

start: A workout is open; member starts another from a routine page

user_sees: The watch opens for the new workout
must_not: The watch left on the discarded workout

start: Settings > 'Open MettleUp on my watch' switched off

user_sees: The watch stays as it was

start: Free member (no MettleUp Plus, no gym plan)

user_sees: The watch shows the free-part lock words; it does not open by itself
must_not: The watch opening and logging sets on the free part
A gym member whose plan is active treated as free

start: A workout started 5 minutes ago; the app was closed and is opened again

user_sees: The watch is not asked to open again
must_not: The watch jumping to MettleUp on a resume

steps.action: Edit a past workout or log one after the fact
must_not: The watch opening for a correction

start: Setting switched off, then on again

steps.action: Switch on and start a workout
must_not: The setting stuck off after switching on
